text_block_list.text: (There's still time before bed, so maybe I'll do some knitting.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, well then, perhaps I'll do some patchwork.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho.
The dough goes over here... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Did my nail split, I wonder?
It ended up snagging on the fabric..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The thread got all frayed, too.
*sigh*...
